_doc: QA accounts per repo and environment. Mode 600; never committed, never printed in summaries or receipts. 'main' is the account used for most scenarios. The 'guest' entry is not an account: Checkout v2 with a throwaway email on a real domain is the guest path. Saved browser login state lives in ~/.claude/qa/state/<repo>-<env>-<role>.json and is reused until it expires.
